body:
## Objective
Resolve #692 and #691 by correcting `--review-cmd` documentation in `packages/model-ratchet/bin/model-ratchet.mjs` and `packages/model-ratchet/README.md` (`shell: false` tokenized command template, not a shell command; valid reviewer command examples instead of the nonexistent `@adlc/adversarial-review --file {file}`).

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `packages/model-ratchet/bin/model-ratchet.mjs` `--help` and `packages/model-ratchet/README.md` describe `--review-cmd` as a tokenized command template (`spawnSync`, `shell: false`, no shell metacharacters) and include `--findings-exit-code` in the README Usage and Flags table — verify: `node --test packages/model-ratchet/test/integration.test.mjs`
2. `packages/model-ratchet/README.md` and `packages/model-ratchet/bin/model-ratchet.mjs` contain no references to `@adlc/adversarial-review` or `adversarial-review --file` — verify: `node --test packages/model-ratchet/test/integration.test.mjs`
title: model-ratchet: fix shell=false review-cmd help/docs and replace nonexistent @adlc/adversarial-review example (#692, #691)
